title: Depth Converter kit fire log (result.json)
$comment: Written by kit.record_result, one entry per fire, appended never overwritten. kit.read_results tolerates any file with a `fires` list and treats a malformed one as empty (never fatal) — this schema is the documented shape, held by tests, not a runtime gate. schemaVersion stays 1 across ADDITIVE changes (audit DC-6 ruling): 2026-09-06 fires[].generationId (optional) — the OSIDE generation a fire became; every fire recorded before that day is unkeyed (PLAN-SHARED-GENERATION-ID step d).

generationId.description: OSIDE generations.id (UUID v4, canonical lowercase) — the generation this fire became. fires[].generationId == generations.id is the generation half of the join; kit.json.depth.sha256 == request_payload.request.refs[].sha256 is the content half. Absent on every fire recorded before 2026-09-06 and on any fire recorded without --generation.
